canonical_project: Equinix SN1 Salalah data centre (with Omantel)
notes: Equinix officially opened carrier-neutral data centre SN1 in Salalah (Janaif wilayat), Dhofar Governorate, on 7 November 2024 in partnership with Omantel, following their earlier Muscat facility; part of Equinix's strategy to make Salalah a global connectivity hub. Phase-two expansion adding 125 racks was greenlit in Equinix Q3 2024 results for completion by Q2 2025; total rack count and IT MW capacity not fully disclosed.
